h2: NDT training for Middle Tennessee: Chattanooga State, a registered apprenticeship, employer programmes and the Atlantis route
html:
NDT training for Middle Tennessee: Chattanooga State, a registered apprenticeship, employer programmes and the Atlantis route

Nashville searches for an "NDT trade school" or an "NDT training institute near me" run into a gap: the nearest public NDT degree we verified is in Chattanooga, about two hours southeast. Middle Tennessee candidates therefore choose between that college programme, an apprenticeship or on-the-job route with an employer, or self-paced theory with the hands-on practical done at work. Whether you already have an NDT employer decides most of it.

Who offers NDT training for Nashville candidates?

  • Chattanooga State Community College. An NDT technology concentration inside an ABET-accredited Engineering Technology associate degree, covering visual, penetrant, magnetic particle, ultrasonic, radiographic and eddy current testing. Embedded certificates split the work into surface methods, volumetric methods and welding and visual inspection, and students pass written and practical exams administered or approved by a Level III. TVA employees helped build the degree when it began.
  • A registered apprenticeship. In November 2025, Chattanooga State and Valmont Industries announced a registered NDT apprenticeship that lets Valmont employees at its Jasper, Tennessee site earn formal NDT education while working full time.
  • Employer on-the-job training. Testing companies with Nashville offices hire trainees who learn under certified Level II staff, and manufacturers train quality staff in the methods their parts need.

What Middle Tennessee employers ask for

Fabrication drives much of the demand. Applied Technical Services advertised a resident Level II technician role in Nashville, working in a fabrication shop setting, that asked for Level II in shear-wave UT and MT with documented education, training and experience, VT Level II as a plus, and experience with manufactured utility power poles. The role also required a drug screen, a valid driver's licence with a clean record, US person status under export rules, and on-the-job training of trainees. Rutherford County postings titled "CWI and/or MT/PT/UTT/VT Technician" show weld-inspection roles that accept either credential set. Atlantis does not train for CWI, which is an American Welding Society credential.

The useful reading: in Middle Tennessee, shear-wave UT plus MT is the combination that gets a fabrication-shop role, and VT strengthens it.

Starting as an NDT trainee in Middle Tennessee

Trainee roles at testing companies, as ATS describes them, involve preparing equipment and parts, assisting certified Level II staff and logging supervised hours. Formal training in each method, whether from a college, an apprenticeship or an online course, runs alongside that log. Both records feed the Level I, and later Level II, certification your employer issues.

Where can you do NDT Level 3?

Level III is not a course you attend near home. You need years of documented experience, then you pass the ASNT NDT Level III Basic and method examinations, or your employer's Level III examinations under its written practice. You can prepare from anywhere with Atlantis's online ASNT Level III exam preparation.

How to choose an NDT route from Nashville

  • Distance. A two-hour drive to Chattanooga works for a full-time student, not for someone holding a Nashville job.
  • Apprenticeship terms. If an employer offers one, ask how formal training hours, experience hours and the move to Level II are recorded.
  • Method match. Check the course covers shear-wave UT and MT at Level II if fabrication work is the goal.
  • Who certifies. A degree or course gives you training evidence. Your employer certifies you, after exams under its written practice.
  • Practical exam. Ask what real parts or welds you will examine, and who grades the result.

Where the Atlantis route fits for Middle Tennessee

Atlantis has no classroom in Nashville or anywhere else in Tennessee. You complete method theory online on your own clock, ask an ASNT NDT Level III when something is unclear, and the course opens the moment you enrol. Rehearse in the welding workshop and other workplaces of the Practical NDT simulator. The hands-on practical and practical exam take place in your employer's shop, on its equipment and against the written practice it bases on SNT-TC-1A; the employer then signs the certification.

For fabrication roles like the one above, take ultrasonic testing training and magnetic particle testing training, adding visual testing training. Tennessee manufacturers that want their own staff certified can have an Atlantis Level III set up the programme through SNT-TC-1A training programme set-up. See also NDT training in Tennessee and NDT training in Chattanooga.
